name: Raising Spirits

angles.text: As a shaman, you see how orcish shamanism can restore the spirits of veterans still burdened by trauma.
As an orc, you may recognize the dishonor Gor'mul feels at being denied an honorable death beside his former Warchief.
Under Thrall's leadership, the Horde seeks to reintegrate and uplift embittered veterans rather than abandon them to despair.

faq.answer: Gor'mul is an embittered orc veteran who survived the older Horde's conflicts after his Warchief fell. He believes fate cruelly denied him an honorable death beside that leader and rejects ordinary sympathy.

Tor'gan is a shaman trying to lift Gor'mul from despair. He believes ancestral ways can restore broken spirits and shamanism can bring former warriors to spiritual rebirth. He crafts infused charms to remind them of their people's strength.
faq.q: Who is Tor'gan and why is he helping Gor'mul?

aliases: why did gormul throw the amulet
faq.answer: Tor'gan prepared the enchanted amulet to awaken Gor'mul's warrior spirit through shamanic energy. Gor'mul rejected it and threw it to the ground, believing its magic could not dispel his bitterness.
faq.q: What was the purpose of the amulet?

faq.answer: Gor'mul does not name the Warchief he mourns. He curses fate for denying him death beside his fallen leader in battle.
Tor'gan accepts that the amulet lacked enough power on its own. He remains patient and believes shamanism's true power can rekindle Gor'mul's lost pride.
faq.q: What does Tor'gan plan to do after the amulet fails?

aliases: what does this show about shamans
faq.answer: Tor'gan uses shamanism to mend wounded minds and pride among his people. Shamans heal those wounds and channel the elements for war.
faq.q: Why does Tor'gan use shamanism to help Gor'mul?

sections.body: Gor'mul grieves that he survived when his fallen Warchief did not. Many orc veterans bear the weight of past wars, but Gor'mul believes fate denied him an honorable death beside his leader. Tor'gan, a shaman, hopes to ease that sorrow by recalling his people's spiritual strength. He prepares an enchanted amulet and trusts ancestral power to rekindle the old warrior's pride.
sections.title: A Broken Spirit

sections.body: Tor'gan's amulet reaches Gor'mul, but brings no comfort. Gor'mul casts it into the dirt and asks why anyone would show him mercy when fate denied him an honorable end. Tor'gan accepts that one charm cannot overcome years of sorrow. Still, he remains committed to helping Gor'mul, believing the growing practice of shamanism can guide him back to his former honor.
sections.title: The Limits of the Amulet

summary: Tor'gan hopes ancestral magic can restore Gor'mul's pride and will to live. The shaman seeks to lift an old orc veteran from despair.
